addressLine1: Kachiguda Station Road, Opposite Bank of India
aboutParagraph1: Navdurga Hosiery has been dressing women in soft, well-made basics for years — from everyday nightwear to pieces you feel good in under anything. We believe premium doesn't have to mean impractical: every fabric we choose is washed, worn and rechecked before it reaches you.
aboutParagraph2: We've been trusted by our customers in Hyderabad for over 23 years, and that experience is what shapes every fabric and fit we choose today.
